en: The image shows two male wrestlers in the midst of a wrestling match, with one athlete lifting and grappling the other. Both wear vintage wrestling attire: one in a light-colored singlet, the other in a dark one. The scene is set in an outdoor stadium with tiered seating in the background, sparsely occupied by spectators. There is a man in a hat and suit, likely an official or referee, moving towards the wrestlers. A sign marked 'C18' is visible near the center.
